Short title and commencement

SINDH BUILDINGS CONTROL (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1997
SINDH BUILDINGS CONTROL
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1997
An Ordinance to amend the Sindh
Buildings Control Ordinance, 1979
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary,
Part I, 25th October, 1997]
No.S.LEGIS.1(13)/97, dated 25‑10‑1997.‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby published for
general information;‑‑
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑(i) This Ordinance may be called the Sindh
Buildings Control (Amendment) Ordinance, 1997.
(ii) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 19 of Sindh Ordinance No. V of 1979

SINDH BUILDINGS CONTROL (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1997
SINDH BUILDINGS CONTROL
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1997
An Ordinance to amend the Sindh
Buildings Control Ordinance, 1979
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary,
Part I, 25th October, 1997]
No.S.LEGIS.1(13)/97, dated 25‑10‑1997.‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby published for
general information;‑‑
2. Amendment of section 19 of
Sindh Ordinance No. V of 1979.‑‑In the Sindh Buildings Control
Ordinance, 1979, in section 19, in subsection (1‑A), for the existing
proviso, the following shall be substituted:‑‑
"Provided
that no offence relating to building works commenced or carried out in
violation of the regulations framed or deemed to be framed under section 21‑A,
shall be compounded.".
